values.note: Clay County's WebTrac system, six months to one day ahead, or by phone (816-407-3400, option 3, weekdays 8-5); same-day walk-ins buy unreserved sites at the camp host booth (honor envelopes off-season), and may stay a single weekend night. 15 nights in any 30 per campground. Check-in 1 pm, out 11 am (Sunday 5 pm / 3 pm).
Seniors 62 and over: pay 3 consecutive nights in advance and the 4th is free.

note: Clay County Parks campground on the south side of Smithville Lake off E Highway, the larger of the county's two: paved loops on the peninsulas north of the entrance, back from the shore behind the perimeter road, and more loops on open ground to the south. --Claude
